params.test: POST-HOC replication of the fold separation on an enlarged panel, plus a threshold-free continuous test
params.registered_result_being_replicated: AUC 1.000, p 0.0009, 14 vs 4 chains (run_proteins.py, commit c060fe9)

runs.preprocessing: alpha diagrams of every protein chain in the extended panel

stats.name: auc_h1_small_bar_density_extended
stats.multiplicity: post hoc; not corrected, and not pre-registered

stats.name: auc_unbanded_h1_bar_count_per_residue_extended
stats.multiplicity: post hoc; reported to show whether the pre-registered 4.5 A band contributes anything over an unbanded bar count

stats.name: spearman_helix_frac_vs_h1_small_bar_density
stats.null_model: 2000 permutations of helix_frac against the same densities

stats.name: spearman_sheet_frac_vs_h1_small_bar_density
stats.null_model: 2000 permutations of sheet_frac against the same densities

stats.name: spearman_n_CA_vs_h1_small_bar_density
stats.null_model: 2000 permutations of n_CA against the same densities

controls.description: size-only confound control on the enlarged panel: AUC from n_CA alone

band-necessity control: the same test on the UNBANDED count of H1 bars per residue. If it matches the banded AUC, the pre-registered 4.5 A cut-off is doing no work and the statistic is simply 'H1 bars per residue'.
controls.detail: banded AUC 0.932 vs unbanded 0.932 (p 0.0001); on the registered panel both were 1.000

controls.description: threshold-free control: the same association measured as a Spearman correlation across all protein chains, so it does not depend on the 0.30/0.05 fold-class thresholds

findings.claim: POST-HOC: on an enlarged panel of 14 all-alpha vs 20 all-beta chains, h1_small_bar_density gives AUC 0.932 (permutation p 0.0001) against a size-only AUC of 0.411. Threshold-free, across all 58 protein chains, h1_small_bar_density correlates with helix_frac at Spearman rho 0.6904 (p 0.0005) and with chain length at rho 0.4379 (p 0.0005).
findings.caveat: POST HOC. The panel was enlarged after the registered result was known. This replicates, it does not independently confirm. The fold classes are this pipeline's HELIX/SHEET counts, not CATH or SCOP.
